title: Poker Now Session Bankroll Delta Leaderboard
dataSources: BoardGameGeek plays (`bgg:play`), Poker Now sessions (`pokernow:session`), Bridge Base Online boards (`bridgebase:board`), and Lichess tournament rounds (`lichess:tournament`).
app: BoardGameGeek play logs, Poker Now session exports, Bridge Base Online boards, and Lichess tournament data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pokernow:session bankroll_delta_usd=*
| stats sum(bankroll_delta_usd) as total_value, avg(bankroll_delta_usd) as avg_value by table_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks table name values by total and average bankroll delta across Poker Now session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `bankroll_delta_usd` values for each Poker Now session event and review total and average bankroll delta by table name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total bankroll delta.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which table name shows the biggest bankroll delta numbers in your Poker Now session data.
